description: Showed the recopied roll, and entered the cap, not the turnip.
name: Abel Garnish

description: Gave the empty galleries a king, and asked for a different one.
name: Richard Burbage

description: Measured the argument against the business, and called it done.
name: Thomas Pope

description: Objected to being pinned, and kept the turnip as a threat.
name: Will Kemp

description: Promised to set new matter down at Easter, and named the cap.
name: William Shakespeare
